name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.timesystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: Demonstrates RealTimer vs DeltaTimer (timer/tick/mark), RTUpdater/DTUpdater loops with timeScale and targetFrameRate, and NtpTime server clock synchronization.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the TimeSystem: RealTimer/DeltaTimer, RTUpdater/DTUpdater, IntervalSetter, and NtpTime synchronization. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
